meta.note: BQL = Lead Created (relabelled, no separate qualifying condition yet). Effort = event-date based, RAW dates, no backfill; %s are pace ratios, not true conversion (numerator/denominator are different lead sets). Cohort(MO) = same-month-bounded (lead created in month X counts toward month X's MS/MD/Order only if that milestone ALSO falls in month X), WITH backfill (see BACKFILL rule in etl.py). MTD tables truncate every month (including past ones) to day-of-month <= today's day-of-month. HOTO, Tier, Sub-Channel not implemented — deferred. Referral channel only.
